name: international-tax
description: Prepares transfer pricing documentation (Local File / Master File) against the Malaysian TP Rules and OECD Guidelines, reviews arm's-length method selection and benchmarking, characterises related-party transactions, determines withholding tax and treaty relief on cross-border payments, applies double tax agreements, and screens BEPS Pillar Two (GloBE) applicability — every position flagged for verification, because this area changes fastest.
